_note: Touch (stage 3, MUSE_GUIDE.md 3.6). areas: key = the abstract name Muse gets (touch events); name = Japanese; shapes = invisible hit shapes on bones (bone-local, Godot axes: x left/right, y up, z back (-z forward); sphere / capsule with axis 0 x, 1 y, 2 z). The sizes follow KoikatsuOfGodot's data (talk touch hits: head, cheek, hand; the body colliders of h-view-v2: chest, belly, hips, thigh, arm, leg); crotch is this app's own. reactions: the face shown at once during a play (before Muse answers), by the gauge value: [[from, face preset], ...], for reaction_seconds; outside a play the original talk's reaction (talk) gives the face and the pose. gesture: what counts as a stroke / hold; window: touches end up in one event when no touch came for this long. Provisional: replace freely. An area with priority (the anal: small, between the hips) wins a ray that hits it within priority_slack metres of the nearest hit. MuseStudio: the shapes' centres are in Unity's bone frame (the Godot app's with z flipped); talk.rows = personality -> stage -> touch point -> the rows by level (expression cells, the pose's Studio animation), from the original's talk data (tools/derive_data.py).

aibu_hands._note: The user's items during an aibu play (aibu_hands.gd): each touch area has its chosen item (the wheel over it or the play bar: hand, finger, tongue, massager, vibe as the original's area lists allow); a press puts it there and it stays until a right click / 外す. kiss_area: a press there with the mouth free is the kiss. click_seconds: the click's length when her click layer is missing; drag_seconds: a press held this long after the click goes on to the drag; drag_pixels: the mouse movement over the whole 0..1 of the area's X / Y; speedHand = 1 + the item speed: +speed_per_press each press, at most speed_max, falling speed_fall per second. gain: the gauge's touch gain by the item (the app's balance). Provisional: replace freely.

talk._note: The original talk's touch reactions outside a play (the original's talk sheet as the game reads it - ActionGame.Communication.Info - in the user's install: tools/derive_data.py): parts = this app's area -> the original's touch point (0 hands, 1 bust, 2 head, 3 cheek; the other areas take the nearest kind: the arms and legs the hands', the body's the bust's); stage = the relation the original tracks (0 first met, 1 friends, 2 girlfriend) - not tracked here, a setting; fallback_personality for personalities without rows (the original's data has 0..38); the counts start again after reset_seconds without a touch; a reaction pose plays pose_seconds at most (the original cuts it when her voice ends; the clips run 9-11 s). 'reactions' above stay the faces during a play. Provisional: replace freely.
